content:
ana: Quick planning thread  we need to finalize the observable launch scope for the console sprint. customer asks: per-route cost, tiny trace hooks, and better error buckets. who volunteers acceptance criteria?

mike: Ill pick up the trace hook API. keep it tiny: two events (start,end), sample boolean, and attach trace_id. attach-only metadata by default.

ruchi: Ill do the cost surfaces. MVP = aggregated per-route + per-model over 7d and a live 1h window. no per-request rows at launch. CSV export for finance.

sam: Ill own the dashboard flows. proposing three panels: latency (p50/p95), cost by route, error groups with representative traces. drilldowns 1h/24h/7d.

nate: error analytics owner here. grouping by error signature + prompt fingerprint. add a regression alert. need to confirm retention and cardinality caps.

ana: note from privacy/legal: do not store raw prompts by default. sampled prompts only, and must be redacted.

mike: agreed. SDK emits metadata: route_id, model, token_count, trace_id. full prompt included only on explicit sample=true and after redaction consent.

ana: proposed launch acceptance checklist:
- Dashboards: top-5 routes, p50/p95 latencies, tokens/day, cost/day (7d window)
- Trace hooks: SDK + server shim, sample rate config, python + ts examples
- Cost breakdown: aggregated per-route & per-model, CSV export
- Error analytics: grouping + link to up to 3 sample traces, regression alert (>50% relative increase)
- Privacy: prompts redacted by default; sampled prompts opt-in only

sam: UX ask: keep drilldown to a route timeline as default. customers requested quick timeline lookups.

ruchi: storage plan: pre-aggregate 1h buckets for the 7d window. need DATA task to own rollups. nate?

nate: Ill add rollup job to backlog. agree schema minimal: timestamp, route_id, model, token_sum, cost_estimate, error_count, latency_p50, latency_p95.

mike: SDK minimal payload example: \n```json\n{ "route_id":"string", "model":"gpt-x", "token_count":42, "trace_id":"uuid", "event":"request_start" }\n```\nserver shim will append latency and error markers on request_end.

ana: rollout question: do we gate SDK rollout canary? some customers will flip it cluster-wide.

ruchi: default opt-in per-workspace. Hosted default sampling 0.1% until we validate. Dedicated customers can opt-in fully.

sam: UX acceptance: reach a sample trace within 3 clicks from console home. wireframes by EOW.

mike: will provide example integrations + perf harness to show <50ms overhead.

nate: alerting defaults: regression threshold = 50% relative increase OR absolute 0.5% error_rate, whichever fires first. include mute window for deploys.

ana: risks & mitigations:
1) inaccurate cost estimates -> conservative model + audit export
2) prompt leakage -> redact by default + opt-in samples
3) noisy high-cardinality routes -> top-K cap + sampling

mike: add per-customer telemetry quotas to mitigate runaway.

ana: decisions so far:
- Launch surface = aggregated dashboards + SDK hooks + cost CSV + basic error grouping.
- Privacy = redact prompts by default; sampled prompts require explicit opt-in.
- Rollout = hosted 0.1% default; workspace opt-in for more; Dedicated can enable fully.

ruchi: owners & next steps (JIRA refs provisional):
- ruchi: cost aggregation + quotas (OBS-241)
- mike: SDK + shim + perf tests (OBS-242)
- sam: dashboard UX + wireframes (OBS-243)
- nate: rollups + schema + alerts (OBS-244)
- ana: acceptance checklist + release gating doc (OBS-245)

ana: timing? propose beta behind feature flag in 3 sprints, GA in 8 sprints.

mike: beta in 3 sprints ok if scope = top-5 routes + python/ts SDK only.

sam: wireframes this week, beta visuals in 2 sprints.

ruchi: rollup job + CSV ready for beta in 3 sprints, need infra review.

nate: schema + alert rules in 2 sprints; integration tests sprint 3.

ana: great. Ill draft the acceptance doc and post. tagging as high priority on release board.

ops-bot: Reminder 6aa add deploy checklist to OBS-245 before QA signoff.

ana: thanks all. Ill schedule a short triage tomorrow 9:30am PT. flag any reprioritization on the release board. :sparkles:
